content:
maya: Quick sync — proposing an inference perf readout next week focused on latency vs token-cost tradeoffs. Want to lock agenda + runbook.

sam: +1. Can we include the 8k seq tests and async batching numbers?

ryan: prefer Wed 9am PST or Thu 4pm PST. Which works for infra to reserve GPUs?

ops-bot: Available capacity: Wed 09:00-11:00 PST (8 A100s), Thu 15:00-17:00 PST (4 A100s). :white_check_mark:

lina: I can do Thu 4pm. Suggest we keep it 45m: 15m readout, 20m perf/analysis, 10m action items.

maya: Agenda draft:
- goals & success metrics
- benchmark config & runs
- dashboard walkthrough (latency/cost)
- action items + owners

sam: Proposed runbook snippet:
```
# perf-run.sh
export MODEL=redwood-3b
export SEQS=(512 2048 8192)
for s in "${SEQS[@]}"; do
  ./run_bench --model $MODEL --seq_len $s --batch 1 --measure latency,cost
done
```

ryan: pls include KV cache warmup & steady-state runs; will add flags in CI.

maya: Dashboard links: https://console/redwood/dashboards/latency-cost (mock)

lina: Can someone own collating prompt sets + eval prompts? @sam?

sam: i'll take prompt sets. will post PR with prompts + expected metrics by Tue EOD.

maya: OK lock Thu 2026-03-19 16:00 PST (thread consensus). Lina owner of agenda. Sam owns prompts. Ryan infra for GPUs. Can we add a pre-run checklist 24h before?

devx-bot: Reminder set: pre-run checklist notification scheduled for 1955643066.

maya: thanks — I'll update calendar invite and add runbook link. If anyone can't make it, please drop notes here or nominate a delegate.

ryan: noted.

lina: thanks all :handshake:
